gemini.title: Planning Register Pts 16
gemini.abstract: Planning Register Pts 16 is an authoritative dataset published by Galway County Council. It represents planning register pts 16 features using multipoint geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Galway County Council as open local government data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
